title: The palette's colours come from the table's materials
notes: palette.css trades its 25 Tailwind default colours for jade, lacquer, ink, verdigris, copper, amethyst and pale brass (43 colours, from 50); the board's and menus' status colours follow, and 903 literal colours move onto the palette. Card art, owned cosmetics, playmats and card versions keep their colours.

player.title: Warmer status colours
changes: Glows, damage, healing, timers, map nodes and proficiency stamps are redrawn in jade, lacquer red, ink blue and verdigris, to sit on the table's wood and parchment.
Card art and the cosmetics you own keep their colours.
